summary: Lofgren affirms Israel's right to exist and defend itself against Hamas while calling for a pause in hostilities and urging Netanyahu to recalibrate war efforts to prevent civilian casualties.
quote: I have expressed support for the victims of the attack and the right of Israel to exist and to defend itself against Hamas. I've called on President Biden to secure a pause in hostilities

summary: Lofgren urges all parties to negotiate a permanent ceasefire and calls for a massive increase in humanitarian aid to Palestinian civilians in Gaza with international community help.
quote: As the war in Gaza continues, with horrific loss of life, I urgently call on the parties to negotiate a ceasefire. A massive increase in humanitarian aid for Palestinian civilians in Gaza must also be accomplished

summary: Lofgren calls Gaza a 'humanitarian catastrophe,' blames Netanyahu for famine, demands US pressure, and calls for a two-state solution with security and recognition for both sides.
quote: The Netanyahu government, who controls entry into Gaza, has the responsibility to prevent famine there. The United States has a responsibility to use its influence to push for immediate action.

summary: WhoFundsMyRep reports $38,775 in direct/earmarked contributions across tracked election cycles, chiefly J Street PAC, and no AIPAC PAC/UDP money for Lofgren; this is not a 2026-only total.
quote: As of October 2026, Zoe Lofgren has received no money from AIPAC PAC or its super PAC, United Democracy Project, in FEC filings. Other pro-Israel PACs tracked here — chiefly J Street PAC — account for $38,775
